objective: Recover official XBRL facts from PIT-qualified NSE filing versions, quantify feature breadth/continuity, and only then define fundamental feature mappings.
invariants: Do not reopen Original Roadmap Legs 4, 5, or 6.
Do not delay or replace Original Roadmap Legs 7 or 8.
Do not train or promote any model in Phase 2A.2.
Use only official NSE/BSE filing documents for fundamental facts.
Preserve filing version, reporting basis, quarter, context, unit, namespace, source URL, source SHA, and PIT availability.
Never bridge standalone and consolidated facts unless an explicit continuity rule is later approved.
Never silently map unknown XBRL concepts to canonical financial features.
Profile observed concepts first; canonical feature mapping is a later evidence-driven step.

pilot.selection: Latest PIT-available filing version per symbol/quarter/reporting-basis, while retaining source lineage to earlier versions.

required_outputs: Per-document parser evidence with content SHA256
Numeric fact inventory with concept namespace/local name/context/unit/decimals/scale
Candidate mapping evidence only after observed concept profiling
